title: Impact Of Agriculture On Climate
definition: The bidirectional relationship where agricultural activities act as both a source and sink for greenhouse gases (GHGs), significantly altering global climate patterns through land-use change, enteric fermentation, and synthetic input usage.
importanceInUpsc: High-yield topic for GS Paper III (Environment/Agriculture) and GS Paper I (Geography). Frequently linked to COP summits, Sustainable Development Goals (SDG 2, 13), and India's Net Zero 2070 target.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Impact Of Agriculture On Climate.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Basic understanding of Carbon and Nitrogen cycles
